findings.title: Predicted early failure risk: disk-A
findings.description: Component 'disk-A' shows failure-predictive telemetry. Risk score 55/100.
findings.evidence: Reallocated sectors (SMART 5): 120, rising 14.40/day; Pending sectors (SMART 197): 24, rising 2.80/day
findings.impact: Likely hardware failure — ~9 day(s) to critical threshold at current trend. Unplanned failure can cause data loss, job aborts, or node downtime.
findings.remediation: Schedule proactive replacement / migration of workloads off this component; back up data; open a maintenance ticket. Re-check after the next telemetry interval.
findings.poc: predicted_window=~9 day(s) to critical threshold at current trend; drivers=2
